notes.note: Scanned for claims about origin admission, WebSocket origins, the sign-in picker, live-surface Retry, the input notice, the codec label, the float pill, the Stations pending row and Chromium launch failures; none here describe those mechanics. Changed sources: the module map LiveSurfaceCanvas line now says the codec is a data-codec diagnostic; runtime-routes now builds one StationOriginPolicy (configured origins, then the daemon-attested own Tailscale Serve origin) for the HTTP gates, pairing check and sign-in picker; a launch hang maps to browser-host-failed and stderr is classified per chunk before trimming; the float pill is one row with a status mark instead of a caption row; the input notice is one slim line (under the bar in immersive mode), held-back presses recheck eligibility, the codec label is a data-codec diagnostic only; Retry keeps only input refused before dispatch (surface-busy), per epoch; indeterminate failures replay nothing; the Open failure notice is a component whose How to fix link is a 44px row.
